name: Elemental Burst
body:
School evocation [see text]; Level druid 1, shaman 1, witch 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area 5-ft.-radius burst

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex, see text; Spell Resistance yes

You designate one of the five elements to explode within the area. You choose between earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. The effect of the burst is as follows.

Earth, Metal, or Wood: The burst is made of sharp slivers and fragments of the chosen element. All targets in the burst take 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
Fire: The burst is a swath of flames that deal 1d4 fire damage per caster level (maximum 5d4).
Water: The burst of water deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage and knocks the target prone. A successful Reflex save negates the prone but not the damage.

This spell gains the relevant descriptor based on which element is employed.
